interpretation: Evidence-backed profile of the concrete experimental implementation labeled S2; not a canonical S2 specification.
superseded_interpretation: Do not treat this property set as the semantic definition of S2.

properties.claim: The experimental S2 implementation is a strict additive extension of its experimental S1 implementation by relation_lookup_direct.
The matched v0.2 experiment gives experimental S1 and S2 the same persistent relation representation and stored information.
Tested S1 programs preserve result and machine-state contents under the experimental S2 implementation.
Direct lookup is read-only with respect to machine_data and interpreter store in the current dict-backed fixture.
relation_lookup_direct accepts a Mapping and key, returns the mapped value, and returns NIL for a missing key.
Direct lookup is explicitly charged one access tick; state_read is charged separately.
The direct primitive performs no preprocessing, cache construction, or target-specific representation construction.
Experimental S1 and S2 are semantically equivalent on the recorded five-query workload.
The experimental S2 implementation changes access to an already-read relation value rather than information availability or target timing.
The one-tick direct access accounting is not evidence of a universal O(1) lookup theorem.
The experimental S2 implementation currently depends on host-language Mapping/get semantics.
The evidence does not establish the canonical semantic definition of S2 or an absolute computability separation.
